verdict: the read-ahead window almost never fired: 19 hits and no prefetch at all, so the per-block cost stayed at 132 us
cause: continuation was judged against a single last-end value while several readers interleave their 4 KiB requests, so lba never matched the stored end
next: v51 keeps the ends of the last eight streams; a match on any of them triggers the 32-block prefetch
